1.w: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

2.w: Grace to you⁺ and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.w: We ought to thank God always concerning you⁺, brothers, just as it is worthy, because your⁺ faith is growing exceedingly, and the love of each one of you⁺ all to one another is increasing,

4.w: so as for us ourselves to boast in you⁺ in the churches of God for your⁺ endurance and faith in all your⁺ persecutions and in the tribulations that you⁺ are bearing,

5.w: a plain token of the righteous judgment of God, for you⁺ to be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which also you⁺ suffer.

6.w: For indeed [it is] righteous with God to repay those oppressing you⁺ with tribulation,

7.w: and to you⁺ being oppressed, relief with us at the revelation of the Lord Jesus from heaven with the angels of His power

8.w: in a fire of flame, giving vengeance on those not knowing God and on those not obeying the gospel of our Lord Jesus,

9.w: who will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,

10.w: when He shall come to be glorified in His saints and to be marveled at among all those having believed—because our testimony to you⁺ was believed—in that day.

11.w: For [this] also we pray always for you⁺, that our God may count you⁺ worthy of the calling and may fulfill every good pleasure of goodness and work of faith in power,

12.w: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you⁺, and you⁺ in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
